description: How the enterprise roles around the cloud data and AI platform relate to each other: leaders commission and govern, builders ship AI workloads, and platform operators provision, run, and charge back the estate.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Commissioning and prioritizing data and AI initiatives

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Provisioning environments and running production workloads

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Budgets, cost targets, and consumption chargeback

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Governance standards, posture reporting, and value evidence

relations.name: Commissions AI use cases
relations.description: Prioritizes and funds the assistant, agent, and analytics use cases that builder teams deliver, tying each initiative to a business owner and expected value.

relations.name: Sets data and AI standards
relations.description: Publishes the governance rules, approved data products, and model guardrails that builders must design against before anything touches enterprise or regulated data.

relations.name: Sets platform budget and cost targets
relations.description: Allocates the cloud and AI platform budget and hands the FinOps operator the unit-cost and efficiency targets the estate must hit.

relations.name: Provisions governed environments
relations.description: Provides landing zones, compute, model endpoints, and guardrailed self-service so builder teams start work in minutes instead of raising tickets.

relations.name: Hands workloads to operations
relations.description: Promotes AI workloads into production with runbooks, SLOs, and observability hooks, so the platform team can run, scale, and page on them reliably.

relations.name: Charges back consumption
relations.description: Attributes compute, storage, and inference spend to each builder team through showback and chargeback, making workload economics visible per use case.

relations.name: Reports cost and compliance posture
relations.description: Rolls platform spend, reliability, and security-and-compliance posture up to the data and AI leader as evidence the estate is trustworthy and on budget.

relations.name: Evidences delivered AI value
relations.description: Reports adoption, accuracy, and business-outcome metrics per shipped use case, feeding the leader's value story for continued AI investment.
